title: irlpls Delivery (DRAFT)
description: GET {endpoint}/orders/{id}/delivery. Items are shaped like Job results[] (STANDARD Section 6) plus media hashes; provenance states, stage by stage, what the provider evidences or claims. Draft: docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md.

complete.description: true exactly when the order is delivered.

items.description: Item ids are unique within an order; a delivery with a repeated id is malformed.

provenance.description: Applies to every item unless the item carries its own.

relayed_by.description: Routers and shims the data passed through (custody).

url.description: The item's media file, nothing else (other links go in x- members). Requires sha256, media_type and bytes.

sha256.description: Required with url, whatever the media_type; the client checks it after download and fails the item on a mismatch.

stac.description: Optional embedded STAC Item for geospatial results.
